notes.title: Nocturnal Nemesis v2.0 Now Available (Early Access Release)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce that [b]Version 2.0[/b] of [i]Nocturnal Nemesis[/i] is now live for players on the [b]default branch[/b]! This marks the beginning of our [b]Early Access phase[/b], bringing major changes, new features, and significant improvements over the original alpha demo.

🆕 [b]What’s New in v2.0:[/b]

🚨 [b]Early Access Expansion[/b] – A deeper, longer, and more atmospheric experience.

🌌 [b]New Areas[/b] – Explore fresh environments filled with new secrets and tension.

🧠 [b]Improved AI[/b] – Smarter, creepier enemy behavior to keep you on edge.

📹 [b]Enhanced Visuals[/b] – New effects, lighting tweaks, and refined performance.

🛠️ [b]Core Systems Reworked[/b] – Major backend improvements for stability and smoother gameplay.

🔊 [b]Audio Overhaul[/b] – Immersive sound design with expanded ambient and environmental effects.

🔐 [b]Accessing v2.0:[/b]

This update is [b]password-protected[/b] as part of a [b]limited Early Access rollout.[/b]

If you’re participating in the test, you’ll need to enter the steam key code to download the update. If you don’t have it yet, stay tuned!

🎮 [b]Still Want the Demo?[/b]

No worries — the original [b]alpha demo[/b] is still available under a new branch in the [b]Betas[/b] tab. You can switch to it anytime:

Right-click [i]Nocturnal Nemesis[/i] in your Steam Library.

Go to [b]Properties[/b] → [b]Betas.[/b]

Select the branch named legacydemo (no code needed).



Thanks for sticking with us. Your feedback means the world, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about the new build.

Stay safe in the dark 👁️
— The Nocturnal Nemesis Team

notes.title: 🚨 Big Update - We're Back in Action! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Preview of the 1.0 office from the Alpha Demo version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147493/d319d03b4e776555fcad7ee1b52010ab9e96cea6.png[/img]

[b]Preview of the 2.0 office from the Early Access version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147493/b973eb591855c16b864d3cc11b232bba93903f60.png[/img]

It’s been a while since we last updated you here on Steam, but we’ve been hard at work—and we’re finally back with some exciting news! Here’s what’s changed since our last update:

✅ [b]We've moved into Early Access (v2.0)[/b]
✅ A new [b]eerie atmosphere:[/b] subtle changes to keep you on edge
✅ Major updates to [b]game mechanics[/b] and [b]visuals[/b] for a smoother experience
✅ A [b]creepy phone system[/b] is now part of the game… yes, really.
✅ And yes, we’ve been improving everything, from the office to the gameplay.

We'll be rolling out detailed updates over the next few days, so stay tuned. Consider this post your "catch-up card" before we fully restart our devlog journey. And yes, expect sneak peeks into the game’s progress—video teasers are coming too 👀

🔧 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
More updates are coming soon, so don’t go too far. We can’t wait to show you the next steps as we keep pushing towards the final version.

Thank you for sticking with us! We couldn’t have done it without your support.

[b]Let's do this![/b] 🚀
